title: Nourishing Crisp Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: This salty and crisp Algerian dish features chicken cooked in a tagine, perfect for a romantic dinner, and is low in glycemic index for a healthier meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
